summary: Final re-audit of Phase S3 after remediation round 3, at audited head bb7b1f08. The round commits since my r3 PASS at b6ae211f are 6aa56a84, f8432337, f37a6b7e, ea90cc4e, and bb7b1f08. Verdict: PASS. (1) The rule and the parent list close the three routed items. The sweep parent list is [REPO_ROOT, apps, ...WORKSPACE_DIRS] (oxc-toolchain-gates.test.ts:167) and WORKSPACE_DIRS at line 1347 holds each apps/* and packages/* folder, so every depth-one in-repo seed parent is swept. My grep of every seedDir call found only REPO_ROOT, the apps parent, IM3_DIR, APP_SHELL_DIR, and workspace dirs, plus two pinned controls that sit outside the list by design (the r3 a controls under os.tmpdir() at line 1015, outside the repository, and the r3 b control under apps/integrated-math-3/curriculum at line 1056, two levels deep). F7 and F1r3 are closed live: the seed check swept apps/.oxlint-probe-LEAK/x.ts and apps/integrated-math-3/.oxlint-adv13-LEAK/x.ts during '-t S2 adversarial' (13 passed), and both folders were gone after. F2r3 is closed live: isSeededProbeDirName (lines 141-147) matches '.oxlint-probe-' or '.oxlint-adv' followed by '-' or a digit, so the near-miss apps/integrated-math-3/.oxlint-advisory-KEEP stayed; seedDir (lines 152-159) validates each prefix and maps the bare '.oxlint-adv' form to '.oxlint-adv-', so no seed name can escape the rule: the digit forms '.oxlint-adv8-' through '.oxlint-adv13-' (lines 2167 to 2601) all match, and seedDir throws before mkdtempSync on any other form. (2) The f37a6b7e diff holds four hunks: the helper block, the parent list, and the two flipped r3 b expectations, with comment lines only besides; the r3 a case, every other case, and every other expectation are untouched, and the two code changes strengthen the file (a stricter seedDir guard, a narrower sweep match). (3) The plan changes in ea90cc4e are true: every count in the Round 3 line reproduced exactly (S3 adversarial 14, S3 tsrs 8, S2 adversarial 13, gates-script file 23, full scripts suite 86 passed with only the pre-existing remediate-concept-blueprints row, tsc exit 0), the proof seed set in the line matches my live seed check, the Round 2 correction is accurate, and the new task line (plan.md:438) is a top-level [x] task with a SHA inside the S3 block, so the role gate counts 11 S3 tasks with zero non-deferred incomplete; the checkpoint sub-items stay indented and the [b] user-verification line stays deferred. The single full-suite failure is pre-existing at the audited tree: the row requires apps/integrated-math-3/curriculum/implementation/practice-v1/activity-map.json in its scan set and the tracked tree at bb7b1f08 holds no such file. (4) One new Nit F9: the Round 3 sentence 'Every seedDir call has its parent in that list' overstates by the two pinned controls; a stale two-level-deep seed survives the sweep by design and would turn a later run red on adv 7, the same interrupted-run residual class as the accepted F8. F3 to F6 carry unchanged: the round diff on tech-stack.md, tech-debt.md, and oxc-evidence.md is empty. All suite re-runs ran in a detached worktree at bb7b1f08 under /tmp/opencode, because a parallel adversarial r4 session was active in the main checkout and rewrote the gates/s3 artifacts during this audit.
nonblocking_findings: F9 [Nit] review-a: the Round 3 plan sentence 'Every `seedDir` call has its parent in that list' (measure/tracks/vinext-oxc-toolchain_20261114/plan.md:442) overstates the coverage: two seedDir calls sit outside the parent list by design. The r3 a controls seed under os.tmpdir() (scripts/__tests__/oxc-toolchain-gates.test.ts:1015, outside the repository), and the r3 b control seeds under apps/integrated-math-3/curriculum (line 1056, two levels deep). Both are pinned controls in passing cases, and every depth-one in-repo seed parent is in the list [REPO_ROOT, apps, ...WORKSPACE_DIRS]. Rationale: the record should name the two controls, so a reader does not conclude that a curriculum-depth seed is swept. A stale two-level-deep seed survives the sweep by design (the sweep never walks the tree), and it would turn a later run red on adv 7, the same interrupted-run residual class as the accepted F8. It hides no failure and deletes no tracked or user file, so it is nonblocking under the PM cap. Fix owner Green, one sentence at the next record touch.
